name: Silent Summer Orlando 2019

venue.name: Black Belt Center
venue.details: Venue is a martial arts studio, enter through the double black doors, overflow parking is across the street at Publix

information:
The main event of this competition is 3x3 Blindfolded.

Lunch (Pizza) will be included for competitors on Day 1

If we are ahead of schedule and have sufficient scramblers on Day 2, we will add a Final Round of 7x7 with 12 competitors and then a Final Round of Feet with 12 competitors.
